title: In nested CALCULATE an inner ALL removes the outer filter
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( Customer[Country] ) ), Customer[Country] = "JP" ) )

source.quote: the ALL ( Customer[Country] ) removes any of the effects of the external filter
source.supports: the outer filter is applied first and the inner ALL on the same column then removes it

derivation: Outer: Country = JP. Inner: ALL ( Customer[Country] ) removes that filter. Grand total 540.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
